# Fixture report — a dangling escalation

SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not archive data. Rule 50: this declares an escalation against a ledger id
that does not exist. Either the id is wrong or the issue was never filed, and both mean the
finding is unreachable from the ledger — the exact state that lost findings in Pass 3.

escalations:
  - [P99-1] A fixture finding against an issue that does exist, so the file is not uniformly bad.
  - [P99-9] A fixture finding against an issue that does NOT exist.
